widthMode.description: Fixed uses width in pixels; hug fits content; fill uses available parent space. Defaults to fixed.

heightMode.description: Fixed uses height in pixels; hug fits content; fill uses available parent space. Defaults to fixed.

lineHeight.description: Unitless line-height multiplier, such as 1.35 or 1.5, never pixels. Default 1.35.

icon.description: Lucide icon name for an icon layer, such as x, check, chevron-left or battery-full. fill is its line color, strokeWidth its line weight (default 2).

component.description: Mark a frame as a reusable main component. Nested components are not supported.

componentId.description: Link an instance frame to a main component id. Its children are generated and follow the main component.

textStyle.description: Text style name in the pinned design kit.

bindings.description: Bind spacing fields and radius to named tokens in the pinned kit.

componentProperties.description: On a main component, expose named properties bound to a source layer field. options restricts allowed states.

componentValues.description: On an instance, values for properties exposed by its main component, such as label or icon.

componentSourceId.description: Generated reference from an instance descendant to its main layer. Edit the main component or detach the instance.

intent.description: text-only preserves all fields except text and all computed bounds. fit-text permits geometry within textIds and layoutIds subtrees, preserving styles and other copy. Layout must fit before saving. No automatic repair.
